name: @tundralibs/pact
description: Permissions, Authentication, Control & Tokens — a transport-agnostic authentication & authorization toolkit: RBAC BigInt-bitmask permissions, JWT & opaque sessions with refresh-token rotation, five credential schemes (password, JWT, API keys, HMAC, tokens), TOTP MFA, and an OAuth2/OIDC client over flat bring-your-own-storage hooks
